name: id
business_description: Unique row identifier for this crop sale record.

name: status
business_description: Lifecycle status of the record (open, closed or cancelled).

name: block_code
business_description: Administrative block code where the sale was recorded.

name: central_subsidy
business_description: Central government subsidy amount on this sale.

name: crop_id
business_description: Identifier of the crop that was sold.

name: cumulative_sale
business_description: Running total held against this record; whether it measures quantity or value is not stated by the field name.

name: device_id
business_description: Identifier of the device used to enter the record.

name: device_user_name
business_description: User name of the person who entered the record on the device.

name: dist_code
business_description: District code of the location where the sale was recorded.

name: distribution_type
business_description: Type of distribution route used for this crop sale.

name: farmer_share
business_description: Share of the sale amount payable to the farmer.

name: mausam_id
business_description: Season reference taken from the Mausam source system; the exact meaning is not stated by the field name.

name: prajati_id
business_description: Reference to the prajati (crop variety or class); the exact meaning is not stated by the field name.

name: quantity
business_description: Quantity of crop sold under this record.

name: receipt_no
business_description: Receipt number issued for the sale.

name: registration_id
business_description: Registration reference linked to this sale record.

name: sales_date
business_description: Date on which the sale was recorded.

name: sell_price
business_description: Price at which the crop was sold.

name: state_subsidy
business_description: State government subsidy amount on this sale.

name: store_id
business_description: Identifier of the store or centre holding the stock.

name: trans_mode
business_description: Mode of transport used for the transaction.

name: transaction_no
business_description: Transaction number of the sale.

name: transaction_type
business_description: Type of transaction recorded for the sale.

name: year_id
business_description: Financial or crop year this sale belongs to.

name: consume_land
business_description: Land area recorded as consumed for this crop; the unit is not stated by the field name.

name: remaining_land
business_description: Land area recorded as remaining for this crop; the unit is not stated by the field name.

name: total_land
business_description: Total land area recorded for this crop; the unit is not stated by the field name.

name: batch_number
business_description: Batch number of the stock issued or sold.

name: caste_id
business_description: Caste category reference of the beneficiary.

name: bill_number
business_description: Number of the bill raised for this sale.

name: master_store_id
business_description: Identifier of the parent or master store.

name: departmental_scheme_id
business_description: Identifier of the departmental scheme funding this sale.

name: departmental_scheme_name
business_description: Name of the departmental scheme funding this sale.

name: agency_id
business_description: Identifier of the agency that executed the sale or distribution.

name: subsidy_from_top_up_project
business_description: Subsidy received from the top-up project on this sale.

name: top_up_scheme_id
business_description: Identifier of the top-up scheme applied to this sale.

name: top_up_scheme_name
business_description: Name of the top-up scheme applied to this sale.

name: top_up_max_subsidy_amount
business_description: Maximum subsidy amount allowed under the top-up scheme.

name: top_up_max_subsidy_percentage
business_description: Maximum subsidy percentage allowed under the top-up scheme.

name: bill_type
business_description: Type of bill raised for this sale.

name: store_type
business_description: Type of store or centre the stock belongs to.

name: cafeteria_id
business_description: Identifier of the cafeteria associated with the sale.

name: bill_upload
business_description: Reference to the bill document uploaded for this sale.

name: change_mainschemeid
business_description: Identifier of the main scheme after a scheme change; the field name appears to be missing an underscore.

name: unit_name
business_description: Name of the unit or centre the sale is recorded against.

name: unit_id
business_description: Identifier of the unit or centre the sale is recorded against.

name: updated_departmental_scheme_id
business_description: Updated identifier of the departmental scheme after a correction.

name: updated_departmental_scheme_name
business_description: Updated name of the departmental scheme after a correction.

name: updated_top_up_scheme_id
business_description: Updated identifier of the top-up scheme after a correction.

name: updated_top_up_scheme_name
business_description: Updated name of the top-up scheme after a correction.

name: modified_by
business_description: User who last modified the record.

name: modified_at
business_description: Timestamp when the record was last modified.

name: previous_central_subsidy
business_description: Central subsidy amount applied before the current revision.
